step_sizes: Each seed inherits the 12 frozen Full raw step parameters; reuse final parameter after step 12, exactly as Full.
objective: Unchanged frozen LayerGeometricSingleGW, all terms retained
decoder: Unchanged frozen known-K endpoint wrapper, argmax unchanged when all K present
selection: Per round, first minimum full hard objective across 10 starts; no truth access
comparison_scope: Conditional initialization intervention with Full-trained steps held fixed, not a standalone untrained solver benchmark
driver_amendment: Cache worker initialization once per process; verify and reuse completed candidates after driver error. No changes to model, initialization RNG, step schedules, horizon or selection.
release_note: Original Full log_eta arrays are provided; checkpoints and checkpoint-based preparation/replay are excluded. Formal random-initialization kernel, seeds, S=100 and selection are unchanged.
